answer: Reputation is minted only by sustained peer-attested work, tracked along a basalt ledger that records each epoch's proofs. Sybil resistance can come from a stake-and-reputation ladder: each new agent must lock a bond of sable tokens that grows with every identity it spawns, so mass fake accounts become expensive. An attacker who tries to split into many identities hits the ridge where bond costs outrun any reward, making the swarm unprofitable. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
